name: Tárnok (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part and a dark red lower fly part, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tárnok: a white shield with a red bell tower, a bunch of grapes and ears of grain, inscribed 1241.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
